en: The image shows a black-and-white view of a small town set against a forested hillside. In the foreground is a church with a tower, surrounded by trees. Other buildings, including a large institutional-looking one on the right and several other smaller structures, are visible among fields. The overall scene suggests a tranquil, picturesque spa town or rural resort area. The text at the bottom is written in German.
